snippet.title: Sonic Mushroom Blast: Legacy - Version 1.5 (Release Trailer)
snippet.description:
This post-SAGE update for Sonic Mushroom Blast: Legacy adds in all the cut content that was originally meant for the SAGE 2025 showcase, including 2 Sonic R race tracks, and 4 additional bonus levels sprinkled throughout the castle walls. 

Download Link:
https://romhacking.com/hack/sonic-mushroom-blast--legacy
Mirror:
https://gamebanana.com/mods/631553
